Mays, Inc., a New York corporation having its office at 9 Bond Street, Brooklyn, NY 11201 ("Grantee"). WHEREAS,Grantor is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land together with the improvements thereon in the Borough of Brooklyn, City of New York (known as 486-496 Fulton Street and as part of Block 159, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of The City of NewYork) and more fully described in Schedule A annexed hereto (the "Schedule A Property"); and  WHEREAS, Grantee is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land together with the improvements thereonin theBoroughof Brooklyn,CityofNewYork (knownas 25ElmPlace and as Block 158, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of The City of New York) and more fully described in Schedule B annexed hereto (the “Mays Building"); and WHEREAS,concurrently herewith Grantee leased certain space and granted certain easements to Grantor in the MaysBuilding, and WHEREAS, Grantee is desirous of obtaining an easement which runs along, under, over, across and/or through a portion of the Schedule A Property for the purpose of maintaining certain equipment and systems including water tanks, HVAC equipment and pipes, cables,wires, conduits, connectors, etc. (collectively the "Systems"); NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants ($10.o0) by Grantee to Grantor, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged by Grantor, it is mutually agreed as follows: 1.
